headerDisplay: Every station you mark as a favourite in moOde's radio list becomes a switch in the Home app. Turning one on plays it on moOde and turns the others off.

host.title: moOde host
host.description: Host name or IP address of the moOde player.

includeFavorites.title: Switches for moOde favourites
includeFavorites.description: Create a switch for every station marked as a favourite in moOde. The list is read each time Homebridge starts; restart Homebridge (or the plugin's child bridge) after changing favourites in moOde.

pollSeconds.title: Status check every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the switches are synced with what moOde is really playing.

stations.title: Extra stations (optional)

name.title: Station name in moOde
name.description: Exactly as shown in moOde's radio list, e.g. Radio Swiss Jazz.

label.title: Name in Home / for Siri
label.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the moOde name. Keep it short and easy to say.

stations.description: Only needed for stations that are not favourites in moOde, or to give a favourite a shorter name for Siri.
